messages:
Emily Chen: Quick sync — AcmeHealth POC timeline and owners. Key dates: trial kickoff 2026-03-30, network ready by 2026-03-24, data sync by 2026-03-28, smoke test 2026-03-31, success review 2026-04-10. Can owners confirm dependencies and blockers? Specifically: VPC peering slot, SSO test user, sample PHI-scrubbing pipeline, model variant for burst. @Priya @Jared @Liam @Tess
Priya Nair: VPC peering slot requested with infra team. I can do peering on 2026-03-24 09:00 PT if CIDR and account IDs are final. Need cust to confirm overlap and whether transit gateway required. Also need SG rules for port 443/1024-65535? :thinking:
Tess Morgan: I'll ping AcmeHealth for CIDRs + test account today. Success criteria from customer: end-to-end latency <500ms for avg 64-token gen, and redaction of PHI before logs leave customer env. Budget cap USD 1,500/day for trial. I'll add to doc. :white_check_mark:
Jared Wells: For model pick, recommend mosaicml/mpt-30b-instruct (quantized q4f16) for throughput. If latency target not met, fallback to mpt-7b-8k q5x for burst. @Priya need to confirm GPU availability on that date for dedicated runner.
Priya Nair: Checking capacity — likely need to reserve one A100 pool for the smoke window. If not, we can route to hosted fallback but cost profile changes. I'll flag with eng-infra.
Liam Park: Security checklist: SSO test user + no PHI stored in logs. Need confirmation on redaction rules — who owns the scrubber? @Sam
Sam Ortiz: Support will own redaction step in the pipeline. We'll provide a Lambda that strips patterns and tokens. Need example PHI tokens and test set by 2026-03-26.
Marta Iglesias: Product ask — can we add 8 canonical prompts to the shared eval set by EOD 2026-03-25? We need them for quality regression checks and canary rollout gating.
Tess Morgan: Added action items to the shared tracker: https://redwood.app/acmehealth-poc (internal) — owners column populated. Please update when you confirm times.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: dedicated-reservation-a100 -> 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z by infra-ci
Jared Wells: Quick CR ping — I've opened PR #4822 for model config and autoscale policy. @Priya can you review batching defaults? small patch, 2 files.
Priya Nair: Reviewing now, will push comments by EOD PST.
Emily Chen: Thanks all — summary: Priya (VPC & capacity), Jared (model + PR), Sam (redaction), Tess (customer coord), Marta (eval prompts). Last message: please add final confirmations to tracker by 2026-03-22 so we can lock reservations.
